guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Fender Stratocaster / ES-335
guitar.evidence: Joe Bonamassa is famous for his large collection of vintage Gibsons (Les Pauls, ES-335s) and Fender Stratocasters; extremely well documented in guitar media.

tone.target: thick blues-rock lead with Marshall crunch
tone.profile: thick blues-rock lead with Marshall crunch
tone.summary: A classic Marshall Plexi-style chain featuring an OD boost for crunch, followed by a robust British amp model and 4x12 cab, finished with subtle delay.
